properties.name: easyai.rag.enabled
properties.description: Whether the EasyRAG integration is enabled.

properties.name: easyai.rag.base-url
properties.description: EasyRAG server base URL; non-blank turns on the deployment-wide STATIC layer (Settings -> RAG becomes read-only).

properties.name: easyai.rag.username
properties.description: Optional credential for EasyRAG JWT login.

properties.name: easyai.rag.password
properties.description: Optional credential for EasyRAG JWT login. Server-side only, never echoed to the console.

properties.name: easyai.rag.workspace
properties.description: Optional EasyRAG workspace; blank means the server default.

properties.name: easyai.rag.top-k
properties.description: Default retrieval top-k.

properties.name: easyai.rag.read-timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout for read operations (search / read / list), in milliseconds.

properties.name: easyai.rag.index-timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout for document insert / delete operations, in milliseconds.

properties.name: easyai.rag.index-submit-timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout for the index submission call (async mode), in milliseconds.

properties.name: easyai.rag.index-poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Initial interval between status polls during indexing, in milliseconds.

properties.name: easyai.rag.index-poll-max-ms
properties.description: Maximum total time to poll for indexing completion, in milliseconds.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.available
properties.description: Deployment-wide kill switch for multi-level memory consolidation. When false no agent, handler or scheduler is wired.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-grouping-prompt-chars
properties.description: Character budget of one grouping-pass prompt, which shows entry index rows (docId, name, blurb, level, stored size) and never bodies.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-sources-per-group
properties.description: Largest cluster one merged entry may absorb.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-group-source-chars
properties.description: Summed stored size of one cluster's sources; a larger cluster is trimmed and, if it cannot fit, refused.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.clusters-per-merge-call
properties.description: Clusters answered by one merge-pass prompt. Each answer re-emits every merged body, so this bounds output, not context.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-merge-prompt-chars-per-call
properties.description: Character budget of one merge-pass prompt (the source bodies it must rewrite).

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-archives-per-run
properties.description: Max source entries archived by one consolidation run.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-iterations
properties.description: Cap on agent-loop iterations for one prompt; there is no tool phase to fit.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.run-timeout-ms
properties.description: Wall-clock budget for one consolidation task: one grouping pass plus the merge prompts it queues.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.dry-run-timeout-ms
properties.description: Wall-clock budget for a preview, which an HTTP request waits on synchronously; a preview is grouping-only.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.default-threshold
properties.description: Per-type threshold used when the user did not override that memory type.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.daily-cron
properties.description: Default daily scan cron (six-field Spring syntax).

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-tasks-per-tick-per-user
properties.description: Max consolidation tasks one scan tick may queue for a single user.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.max-level
properties.description: Consolidation depth at which an entry stops being mergeable material; it stays active and searchable.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.zero-gain-backoff-base-days
properties.description: First delay after a run that finished and found nothing to merge, doubled per repeat.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.zero-gain-backoff-max-days
properties.description: Ceiling of both backoff doublings, so a permanently unmergeable or permanently failing slice is retried occasionally.

properties.name: easyai.memory.consolidation.failed-run-backoff-base-days
properties.description: First delay after a run that could not do its job (it threw, or every prompt was lost), doubled per repeat up to zero-gain-backoff-max-days.
